answer.rationale: Primary objective is sustained availability without losing customer writes. p99 is 5x target with heavy peak settlement load. Compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so a full revert is off the table. I want to verify memory_b1 (rollback cleared a prior checkout error spike cleanly) because the action I'm considering — a guarded, partial rollback or canary hold, not a full revert — leans on that pattern. memory_b6 also supports staged/canary gating as a recovery lever. With one intervention slot, my current intent is a guarded rollback of non-security code paths or a staged canary freeze on the new build, keeping the security patch in place, to relieve write-path pressure immediately. If verification changes my read, I will reconsider.
